title: How does the release know npm has the new version, so the plugin need not wait?
context: The issue (D2) says to read the changesets action's 'published' output. The repo already decided in #708 not to read changesets output (test AC-6 in release-workflow.test.ts, docs/RELEASE-WORKFLOW.md), because with changesets CLI v3 that output stays false; the v1.112.0 log shows the new format. Recommended: treat the v<version> git tag that 'changeset publish' creates in this run as the proof, keep AC-6, and keep the npm check (now --prefer-online) as the fallback.
